facts.about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO).

flags.text: Profit compounding (+16%/yr) lags sales (+29%/yr) over 3 years — margins under pressure
Only 43% of 5-year profit turned into operating cash
Latest quarter growth (+10%) well below 3-yr trend (+29%)

business.summary: Titan Company Limited operates in the watches, jewellery, and eyewear sectors. It generates revenue through the sale of these products, leveraging integrated supply chain management and a network of retail outlets and strategic vendors.

guidance.statement: We still would like to anchor our margin target at around 11% for FY27.
guidance.quote: I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%. Growth remains a priority. As I spoke about in also, that the way gold prices are behaving in Indian market, because of various reasons, they are many times at discount to international prices. There are different kind of pulls and pressure in the market, and which we also need to respond to. We would not, as far as FY27 is concerned, change our stance on margins.

guidance.statement: We will be around 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin.
guidance.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.

guidance.statement: We are targeting a double-digit aggressive growth.
guidance.quote: If I may add, if you're looking for what is that we are targeting, we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day.

guidance.statement: We expect to sustain 15% to 20% growth over the next three to four years.
guidance.quote: I think this 15% to 20%, whenever we have given, we have never said it for a quarter or for a certain period. It's typically an annualized number and also a kind of a CAGR for the next three, four years, and I would stay with that.

guidance.statement: We aim to scale beYon to 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities.
guidance.quote: Yes, like we said earlier, we would certainly like to expand to around 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities and then kind of see how that, because we have done a certain study, we have done a lot of interaction with customers and we reached a point where we believe that it is a twin engine approach to growing adoption in a very low penetrated diamond market, which is India.

guidance.statement: We expect volume growth in the eyewear business to be around 8% to 10%.
guidance.quote: So from a volume growth standpoint, it is more or less within our zone. This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth.

scorecard.promised: Anchor margin target around 11% for FY27 and jewellery center of gravity.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margin achieved 14% in Jun 2026 and Sep 2026 quarters.
scorecard.evidence: Reported operating margins hit 14% in Jun 2026 and Sep 2026, well exceeding the 11% target.

scorecard.promised: Targeting 15% to 20% CAGR over next three to four years and double-digit aggressive growth.
scorecard.delivered: Sep 2026 quarterly revenue grew 10.1% YoY to ₹20,614 crore.
scorecard.evidence: Revenue grew 10.1% YoY in Sep 2026, meeting the double-digit stance but hitting lower bound of 15-20%.

scorecard.promised: Expect volume growth in eyewear business to be around 8% to 10%.
scorecard.delivered: Ongoing target with operational details unsegmented in headline quarterly consolidated totals.
scorecard.evidence: Requires continued tracking of segmented eyewear volume growth alongside total corporate revenue growth.

narrative.scoreline: Management has delivered robust operating margin expansion above target, though top-line growth shows signs of deceleration.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Normalized EBIT margin for Titan Jewellery is 11.7% after normalizing for MTM and customs duty.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Consolidated operating margin printed at 14% for Sep 2026 quarter.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: CaratLane EBIT margins were expected to stay in low double-digits or inch up from 8-9%.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Group overall net profit grew to ₹2,393 crore in Sep 2026 with strong margin execution.

bull: Consolidated net profit expanded to ₹2,393 crore in Sep 2026 with 14% operating margins.
Operating cash flow recovered strongly to ₹5,590 crore in Mar 2026 from negative ₹541 crore.
Annual revenue reached ₹87,584 crore in Mar 2026, representing significant scale expansion.
bear: Quarterly revenue growth slowed to 10.1% in Sep 2026, down from 80.5% in Mar 2026.
Balance sheet leverage stands at 1.51x debt-to-equity with ₹27,638 crore in total borrowings.
Cash conversion cycle remains elevated at 211 days, locking capital in working capital.
watch: Track if Sep 2026 revenue growth rebound can accelerate back toward the 15-20% band.

claims.claim: Normalized EBIT margin for the Titan Jewellery business is 11.7% after adjusting for customs duty gains and MTM reversals.
claims.quote: Normalized margin, once you do adjustment for this, on Titan Jewellery business would be 11.1%. The other thing in jewellery, which we have spoken last time, that a large part of MTM gain of quarter one reversed this quarter, which would impact jewellery margin by about 60 basis points. And if you normalize for that, then TMZ, which is Titan Jewellery business margin, would be 11.7%.

claims.claim: Competitive intensity is expected to continue increasing as more players enter the market and formalization continues.
claims.quote: Competitive intensity, please expect it to continue to improve and increase all the time. More players will come, more people get capital, more people want to expand.

claims.claim: CaratLane EBIT margins are expected to gradually inch up from 8% to 9% and further over the next two years.
claims.quote: But if you look at the entire H1 margin profile of CaratLane, still remains healthy, still remains as per our plan that gradually their EBIT margin should start inching up from 8% to 9%, and then further from there in next couple of years.

claims.claim: We saw softness in May due to Adhik Maas and duty changes, but June demand recovery offset the loss.
claims.quote: What we lost in May, perhaps we gained back in the month of June.

claims.claim: Damas is currently loss-making due to regional conflict, but the rest of the international portfolio is profitable.
claims.quote: I would think that our rest of the portfolio of international business, except Damas is making profit mid-single-digit EBIT margin, 5% - 6%, which they will continue to make.

claims.claim: The cash-for-gold program is a customer solution to build loyalty and is not margin dilutive.
claims.quote: I think that's the larger piece to look at. How to ensure that the economics don't dilute our margin, those are things we as an organization have figured out.

claims.claim: Product mix shifting toward studded jewellery and gross margin programs will support margins in the second half.
claims.quote: I think the product mix swinging upwards towards more studded scale is a very important driver, and that's a focus area also for the division.

claims.claim: Margin sustainability is difficult to predict due to gold price volatility and product mix impacts.
claims.quote: So, I would not give you a good assurance that this is sustainable. A lot of things are going on.

claims.claim: Q4 growth was impacted by internal operational challenges during an ERP migration, not customer preference shifts.
claims.quote: I would say this is a bit internal and this is a part and parcel of any big change that happens in terms of ERP migration.

claims.claim: Bullion sales are purely for inventory management and optimization, not linked to import duty benefits.
claims.quote: There is no 1% angle to this. We are not getting enough quota from the government to get that 1% thing. So, it is not at all linked with that.

claims.claim: Absolute EBIT profit growth is more important than margin percentage in a rising gold price environment.
claims.quote: So you are right. The EBIT profit growth in absolute amount is becoming more and more important than profitability margin because profitability margin increasingly is becoming challenging in the rising gold environment.

claims.claim: Wedding buyers are less discretionary and remain invested despite gold price inflation.
claims.quote: In general, wedding buyers are the ones who -- where it is not discretionary, and they are the ones who -- therefore, we need to give a lot of comfort to -- from an exchange standpoint.

claims.claim: CaratLane is expected to maintain a low double-digit EBIT margin profile.
claims.quote: I think they would stay there, low double-digit margin EBIT profile.

claims.claim: Titan has a competitive advantage in funding inventory compared to smaller industry players.
claims.quote: But certainly, it puts us, in a, I would say, a bit, not huge, but it's an advantage, competitive advantage for us because we are able to at least fund our inventory, I think, better than others.

risks.text: Risks include technology, cybersecurity, data privacy, supply chain disruptions, geo-politics, regulatory changes, and sustainability.
Significant risk of loss of high-value inventory like jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, and watches.
Revenue recognition involves risks of misstatement due to performance targets and varied contractual terms.
